dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Chúa hề? Don't talk nonsense. My friend told me that in Việt Nam there is Chúa hề, a deity of clowns, but I don't believe it.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Chúa hề doesn't actually exist. Your friend is just teasing you. But Vietnamese culture has many interesting thần.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I knew it! My friend always makes up stories about Việt Nam. But I'd like to hear about the real thần of the Vietnamese people.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Vietnamese people worship many different thần, like the God of Fortune or Quan Cong. Would you like to go to a temple with me this weekend? I could tell you more about the deities.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Go to a temple? Aren't you trying to date me or something? But... alright, I want to learn more about Vietnamese people and their thần.
